title: Supply and install only approved gas devices
what: Supply type A gas devices, or install or use any gas device, only once approved by the chief inspector or a holder of a gas device approval authority, and labelled as the regulation requires.

laws.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)

sources.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not supply a gas device (type A), or install or use any type of gas device, unless— (a) the supply, installation or use has been approved by— (i) the chief inspector; or (ii) a person who holds a gas device approval authority for the gas device

sources.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)

sources.quote: chief inspector means the person who, under section 735 , holds appointment as the chief inspector, petroleum and gas.
